links.outcome: Sensitivity of CADe annotation for malignant nodules on local post-deployment data
links.effect: Overall CADe sensitivity on diagnosis CT was 72% (93/129); vessel-suppressed images had higher sensitivity (92%, 119/129).
links.quote: Overall sensitivity of CADe annotation on diagnosis CT examinations was 72% (93/129), whereas vessel-suppressed images demonstrated higher sensitivity (92%, 119/129).

links.outcome: Missed malignant nodules not annotated by CADe, varying by nodule type and location
links.effect: CADe missed 28% of malignant nodules overall; sensitivity was lower for ground-glass (38%) and cystic (13%) nodules, and for subpleural and paramediastinal locations.
links.quote: CADe sensitivity varied significantly by nodule size (P<0.001), was highest for solid nodules (80%) and lower for part-solid (75%), ground-glass (38%), and cystic nodules (13%) (P<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Vessel suppression image display as an adjunct to CADe to improve nodule detection

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world post-deployment sensitivity and failure modes of a deployed commercial CADe/vessel suppression system (ClearRead VIS/CADe) on lung cancer screening patients.
